'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]], [[War crimes in the Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Karim Ahmad Khan|Karim Khan]], the [[Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court]], requests [[arrest warrant]]s for [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]], [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli Defense Minister]] [[Yoav Gallant]], [[Hamas]] political leaders [[Ismail Haniyeh]] and [[Yahya Sinwar]], and [[Al-Qassam Brigades]] leader [[Mohammed Deif|Mohammed Al-Masri]] for alleged [[war crime]]s and [[crimes against humanity]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/icc-prosecutor-seeks-arrest-warrants-israeli-prime-minister-netanyahu-defense-2024-05-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[Haitian crisis]]
**[[Gang war in Haiti]]
***[[Toussaint Louverture International Airport]] in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]], reopens after being closed for three months due to [[Crime in Haiti|gang violence]], as the [[United States Armed Forces|US military]] flies in supplies and civilian contractors to help the [[Haitian National Police|police]] in order to pave a way for an intervention. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-airport-reopening-portauprince-gangs-violence-4db3189b511bdcb4633b395ebf545194 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Red Lobster]], an American restaurant chain, files for [[Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection]]. [https://www.npr.org/2024/05/20/1252426585/red-lobster-bankruptcy (NPR)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse]]
**The [[container ship]] ''[[MV Dali|Dali]]'' is freed from bridge debris since its initial collision on March 26 and is escorted by tugboats back to the [[port of Baltimore]]. [https://apnews.com/article/baltimore-bridge-collapse-ship-refloating-83dde05d3ad999c88dd5270bb0cea1c6 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Russian military commissariats attacks]]
**A court in [[Novosibirsk]], [[Russia]], sentences a 24-year-old man to 25 years in prison for allegedly plotting an [[arson attack]] on a military recruitment office with alleged directions from [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/20/russian-court-hands-25-years-to-arson-plotter-accused-of-ukraine-links (Al Jazeera)]
*Judges grant [[Julian Assange]] permission to appeal his extradition order from the [[United Kingdom]] to the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/wikileaks-julian-assange-faces-us-extradition-judgment-day-2024-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]] denies an appeal by former [[Guantanamo Bay detention camp]] detainee [[Omar Khadr]] to vacate his convictions for his role in the killing of former [[United States Army|U.S. Army]] soldier [[Christopher Speer]] in [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-supreme-court-spurns-former-guantanamo-bay-detainees-appeal-2024-05-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[19th Congress of the Philippines]]
**[[Migz Zubiri]] resigns as [[President of the Senate of the Philippines]] and is replaced by [[Francis Escudero]]. [https://kpl.gov.la/EN/detail.aspx?id=82760 (KPL/VNA)]
*[[2024 South African general election]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of South Africa]] rules that former [[President of South Africa|President]] [[Jacob Zuma]] is ineligible to run in the upcoming parliamentary election due to his 2021 jail sentence. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/20/south-african-court-rules-zuma-not-eligible-to-run-for-parliament (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Vice President of Iran#First vice president|First vice president of Iran]] [[Mohammad Mokhber]] becomes [[provisional government|acting]] [[president of Iran|president]] following the [[2024 Varzaqan helicopter crash|death of]] [[Ebrahim Raisi]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/20/irans-khamenei-confirms-mohammad-mokhber-as-interim-president (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Lai Ching-te]] is sworn in as [[President of Taiwan]], with [[Hsiao Bi-khim]] as his [[Vice President of Taiwan|Vice President]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/20/william-lai-ching-te-takes-oath-to-become-taiwans-new-president (Al Jazeera)]
